name: The 27th Songkhla Marathon 2026
short_description: The 27th Songkhla Marathon 2026 is a full and half marathon event held on August 23, 2026, at Tinsulanonda Stadium in Songkhla, Thailand.
ai_summary: The 27th Songkhla Marathon 2026 is a full marathon event scheduled for August 23, 2026, in Songkhla, Thailand, starting and finishing at Tinsulanonda Stadium. Participants can choose between the full marathon distance of 42.195 km or the half marathon distance of 21.1 km. Registration for this edition is currently closed.
pros: Offers both full marathon (42.195 km) and half marathon (21.1 km) distance options
Held at a dedicated stadium venue, Tinsulanonda Stadium in Songkhla
Long-running event now in its 27th edition
cons: Registration is currently closed, so new sign-ups are not possible

research_highlights: Course starts and finishes at Tinsulanonda Stadium with views of the Gulf of Thailand and Songkhla Lake.
The race gained World Athletics Road Race Label certification in 2023, marking it as an internationally recognised course.
Distances offered are 5K, 10K, half marathon (21K) and full marathon (42K), with the marathon starting as early as 3:00am to beat the heat.
Songkhla's August climate is hot and humid, with a mean daily maximum around 33°C (92°F), consistent with a runner's account of suffering heat effects after a 36°C race.

One long-time runner described the route as scenic and point-to-point, passing fishing boats, palm trees and a long low bridge, with organisers setting up impromptu refreshment stops at residents' gates.
research_watchouts: Heat is a serious factor — one participant reported the race was very hot (36°C) and that he 'suffered badly from the heat for weeks afterwards.'
Organisation has historically been described as 'good but very laid-back' with crowd support present but not large in numbers, based on an older edition review.

Available first-hand participant reviews are sparse and mostly from much earlier editions (2000s), so recent-edition specifics (2023 World Athletics label era) are not yet documented by runner reviews.

faqs.question: When is the 27th Songkhla Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The 27th Songkhla Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on August 23, 2026. The race is held in Songkhla, Thailand, with Tinsulanonda Stadium serving as the venue for the event on that date.

faqs.answer: The 27th Songkhla Marathon 2026 offers two distance options for participants: a full marathon distance of 42.195 kilometers and a half marathon distance of 21.1 kilometers, allowing runners to choose the race length that suits them.

faqs.answer: The race venue for the 27th Songkhla Marathon 2026 is Tinsulanonda Stadium, located in the city of Songkhla, Thailand. This stadium serves as the central point for the event held in this coastal Thai city.
